description: Search the Codenation index of developer and SaaS tools. Every word of `query` must match the tool's name, tags, tagline, category or description; results are ranked by relevance. Filter by `category`, `tag` or `pricing`. Returns short records (slug, name, tagline, category, pricing, tags, website, codenation_url) and the total number of matches. Call get_tool with a slug for the full record and checked price. With no query, lists tools alphabetically.
name: search_tools
title: Search tools
